title: Job list card
guidance: Recompose the card as one coherent unit: title and identity, status, facts, and a consistently placed View job action. Avoid a remote badge and a small stranded action on mobile.
Lifecycle status belongs in the upper-right corner of the card, with job identity/title left aligned. This supersedes the earlier adjacent identity/status placement.

decisions.title: One consistent upper-right state anchor
decisions.reason: The heading spans the whole card: identity left and lifecycle status upper-right. Survey title, fact grid and mobile full-width View job form the body. This supersedes1.6 adjacent state placement.

decisions.title: A purposeful action area
decisions.reason: A stable desktop action column and full-width mobile View job keep the control aligned with its card; no inline Start in the list.
